A '''Relay Pulse Antenna''' was one of two [[Rectenna/Legends|antennas]] that were equipped on [[Sensor beacon/Legends|sensor beacons]] such as [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech's]] [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]]. Alongside the [[Broadcast Antenna]], the Relay Pulse Antenna was located at the top of the beacon, nestled between the two [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]].<ref name="EGWT" />
